This document reports the SAI/PAI and NerMI Valence/Motivation analyses. Statistical analysis code for SAI, PAI, Valence, and Motivation is embedded in this document. The only external dependencies are the input clinical/survey spreadsheets, physiological CSVs, and R packages. ECG preprocessing remains an upstream Python procedure. The report is organized by analytic stream and documents the sequence of models, summaries, screening analyses, and figures used to characterize treatment-related change and its relationship to clinical improvement.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
clean_tbl <- function(df, digits = 3){
  df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits)))
}


head_list <- function(x, n = 6){
  x[seq_len(min(length(x), n))]
}


fmt_p <- function(x){
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x)))
}


htest_tbl <- function(x, label){
  tibble(
    test = label,
    statistic = unname(x$statistic),
    parameter = if(length(x$parameter)) unname(x$parameter) else NA_real_,
    p_value = x$p.value
  )
}


lm_coef_tbl <- function(mod){
  if(is.null(mod)) return(tibble())
  as.data.frame(summary(mod)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble()
}


lm_anova_tbl <- function(mod){
  if(is.null(mod)) return(tibble())
  as.data.frame(anova(mod)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble()
}


phase_lmm_tbl <- function(model_results){

      as.data.frame(model_obj$anova) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        mutate(measure = measure_name, summary = summary_name, .before = 1)
    })
  })
}
```

```{r source-bhi, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, fig.show='hide'}
evalq({


# Pointwise 95% CI for the full four-trajectory DiD contrast.
# Uses model coefficient covariance (not independent curve intervals).
save_did_confidence_intervals <- function(model, grid, prefix) {
  re <- vapply(model$smooth, function(s) if (inherits(s, "random.effect")) s$label else "", "")
  X <- predict(model, newdata = grid, type = "lpmatrix", exclude = re[nzchar(re)])
  V <- vcov(model)
  b <- coef(model)
  keys <- c("Interventi__T1", "Interventi__T0", "Controlli__T1", "Controlli__T0")
  out <- list()
  groups <- if ("measure" %in% names(grid)) as.character(grid$measure) else rep(prefix, nrow(grid))
  for (m in unique(groups)) for (ph in unique(as.character(grid$phase))) {
    rows <- which(groups == m & as.character(grid$phase) == ph)
    for (tt in sort(unique(grid$time_norm[rows]))) {
      ids <- rows[grid$time_norm[rows] == tt]
      lookup <- paste(grid$condition[ids], grid$trial[ids], sep = "__")
      if (length(ids) != 4L || !setequal(lookup, keys)) stop("Unexpected DiD prediction grid")
      xx <- as.numeric(c(1, -1, -1, 1) %*% X[ids[match(keys, lookup)], , drop = FALSE])
      fit <- sum(xx * b)
      se <- sqrt(max(0, as.numeric(t(xx) %*% V %*% xx)))
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- data.frame(measure=m, phase=ph, time_norm=tt,
        DiD=fit, se=se, lower95=fit-1.9599639845*se, upper95=fit+1.9599639845*se)
    }
  }
  result <- dplyr::bind_rows(out)
  dir.create("manuscript_gamm_ci", recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  write.csv(result, file.path("manuscript_gamm_ci", paste0(prefix, "_did_ci.csv")), row.names=FALSE)
  fig <- ggplot2::ggplot(result, ggplot2::aes(time_norm, DiD)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype=2) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin=lower95, ymax=upper95), alpha=.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() + ggplot2::facet_grid(measure ~ phase, scales="free_y") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(x="Normalized phase time", y="(EMDR T1-T0) - (TAU T1-T0)")
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("manuscript_gamm_ci", paste0(prefix, "_did_ci.png")),
     fig, width=11, height=if (length(unique(groups))>1) 7 else 4.5, dpi=300)
  invisible(result)
}


# ANALYSIS INDEX
# ANALYSIS 01: Separate GAMMs for SAI and PAI trajectories
# ANALYSIS 02: Separate clinical prediction GAMMs for SAI and PAI trajectories
# ANALYSIS 03: Clinical outcomes (CAPS change by group)
# ANALYSIS 04: Transition-feature change scores and group / clinical associations
# ANALYSIS 05: Phase-summary mixed models (condition * trial * phase)
# ANALYSIS 06: Phase-specific T1 - T0 change scores vs CAPS
# ANALYSIS 07: Phase-separated T1 - T0 curve plots
# ANALYSIS 08: mLFPCA feature screening, CAPS regression, and reconstructed curves


# =========================================================
# PACKAGES
# =========================================================
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "zoo", "mgcv", "lme4", "lmerTest", "readxl")
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if(length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install)


library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)
library(mgcv)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)


# =========================================================
# FILES
# =========================================================
func_path <- file.path(input_dir, "functional_cleaned_long.csv")
clin_path <- file.path(input_dir, "Participant data.xlsx")
survey_path <- file.path(input_dir, "Dataset for IES-R, STAI Y1 e 2, BDI.xlsx")


raw <- read_csv(func_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
clin_raw <- read_excel(clin_path)
survey_raw <- read_excel(survey_path)


# =========================================================
# SETTINGS
# =========================================================
n_grid <- 100
roll_k <- 11
phase_levels <- c("oc1", "script", "oc2")
descriptive_plot_dir <- "SAI_PAI_descriptive_plots"
moderation_plot_dir <- "SAI_PAI_moderation_plots"
model_output_dir <- "SAI_PAI_model_outputs"


# =========================================================
# HELPERS
# =========================================================
cohen_d <- function(x, y){
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]


  if(length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(NA_real_)


  s_pooled <- sqrt(((length(x) - 1) * var(x) + (length(y) - 1) * var(y)) /
                     (length(x) + length(y) - 2))


  if(!is.finite(s_pooled) || s_pooled == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (mean(x) - mean(y)) / s_pooled
}


safe_median <- function(x){
  if(all(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}


curve_auc <- function(x){
  if(all(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  sum((head(x, -1) + tail(x, -1)) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}


curve_peak <- function(x){
  if(all(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}


curve_trough <- function(x){
  if(all(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}


curve_slope <- function(x){
  if(sum(is.finite(x)) < 5) return(NA_real_)
  tt <- seq_along(x)
  coef(lm(x ~ tt))[2]
}


`%||%` <- function(x, y){
  if(is.null(x)) y else x
}


coalesce_override <- function(base_df, override_df, by){
  override_cols <- setdiff(names(override_df), by)


  merged <- base_df %>%
    full_join(override_df, by = by, suffix = c("", "_override"))


  for(col in override_cols){
    override_col <- paste0(col, "_override")
    if(override_col %in% names(merged)){
      merged[[col]] <- dplyr::coalesce(merged[[override_col]], merged[[col]])
      merged[[override_col]] <- NULL
    }
  }


  merged
}


safe_plot_name <- function(...){
  name <- paste(..., sep = "_")
  name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", name)
  name <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", name)
  tolower(name)
}


condition_display <- function(x){
  factor(
    dplyr::recode(
      as.character(x),
      "Controlli" = "TAU",
      "Interventi" = "EMDR",
      .default = as.character(x)
    ),
    levels = c("TAU", "EMDR")
  )
}


condition_palette <- c("TAU" = "#4C78A8", "EMDR" = "#F58518")
phase_labels <- c("oc1" = "OC1", "script" = "Script", "oc2" = "OC2")


save_analysis_plot <- function(plot, file_stem, directory = descriptive_plot_dir,
                               width = 12, height = 7){
  dir.create(directory, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  out_file <- file.path(directory, paste0(safe_plot_name(file_stem), ".png"))


  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )


  out_file
}


make_two_bin_breaks <- function(x){
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!all(is.finite(rng))){
    return(c(-Inf, 0, Inf))
  }
  if(diff(rng) == 0){
    rng <- rng + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  }
  seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 3)
}


outcome_improvement_label <- function(x){
  med <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if_else(x <= med, "MoreImproved", "LessImproved")
}


save_moderation_plot <- function(plot, measure_name, outcome_name, plot_kind,
                                 width = 12, height = 7){

  out_file <- file.path(
    moderation_plot_dir,
    paste0(safe_plot_name(measure_name, outcome_name, plot_kind), ".png")
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )


  out_file
}


save_print_output <- function(file_name, expr){

  out_file <- file.path(model_output_dir, paste0(safe_plot_name(file_name), ".txt"))
  lines <- capture.output(eval(substitute(expr), parent.frame()))

row_sum_cols <- function(df, cols){
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if(!length(cols)) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))


  mat <- df %>%
    select(all_of(cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()


  rowSums(mat, na.rm = FALSE)
}


ies_subscale_sum <- function(df, visit_prefix, items){
  row_sum_cols(df, paste0(visit_prefix, items))
}


clinical_assoc_by_outcome <- function(df, outcomes, variables){
  map2_dfr(outcomes$outcome, outcomes$label, function(outcome_name, outcome_label){
    spearman_assoc_table(df, outcome = outcome_name, variables = variables) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        outcome_label = outcome_label,
        .before = 1
      )
  })
}


run_clinical_change_summary <- function(clin_df, outcomes){
  map2_dfr(outcomes$outcome, outcomes$label, function(outcome_name, outcome_label){
    clin_df %>%
      group_by(condition) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(is.finite(.data[[outcome_name]])),
        mean_change = mean(.data[[outcome_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        median_change = median(.data[[outcome_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(.data[[outcome_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        outcome_label = outcome_label,
        .before = 1
      )
  })
}


run_clinical_change_tests <- function(clin_df, outcomes){
  map2_dfr(outcomes$outcome, outcomes$label, function(outcome_name, outcome_label){
    dsub <- clin_df %>%
      select(condition, all_of(outcome_name)) %>%
      filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome_name]]), !is.na(condition))


    x <- dsub %>% filter(condition == "Interventi") %>% pull(all_of(outcome_name))
    y <- dsub %>% filter(condition == "Controlli") %>% pull(all_of(outcome_name))


    tt <- if(length(x) >= 2 && length(y) >= 2) t.test(x, y) else NULL
    wt <- if(length(x) >= 1 && length(y) >= 1) wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE) else NULL


    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        outcome_label = outcome_label,
        test = "Welch t-test",
        statistic = if(is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else unname(tt$statistic),
        parameter = if(is.null(tt) || !length(tt$parameter)) NA_real_ else unname(tt$parameter),
        p_value = if(is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else tt$p.value
      ),
      tibble(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        outcome_label = outcome_label,
        test = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
        statistic = if(is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else unname(wt$statistic),
        parameter = NA_real_,
        p_value = if(is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
      )
    )
  })
}


fit_top_feature_model <- function(df, results_tbl, outcome_name, n_top = 4){
  top_features <- results_tbl %>%
    filter(outcome == outcome_name, is.finite(p_value)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    pull(variable)


  if(!length(top_features)){
    return(list(model = NULL, top_features = character()))
  }


  form_txt <- paste(
    outcome_name,
    "~ condition +",
    paste(top_features, collapse = " + ")
  )


  list(
    model = lm(as.formula(form_txt), data = df),
    top_features = top_features
  )
}


smooth_resample_phase <- function(df_phase, value_col, n_grid = 100, roll_k = 11){
  y <- df_phase[[value_col]]
  t <- df_phase$timestamps


  keep <- is.finite(t) & is.finite(y)
  t <- t[keep]
  y <- y[keep]


  if(length(y) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, n_grid))


  ord <- order(t)
  t <- t[ord]
  y <- y[ord]


  t <- t - min(t, na.rm = TRUE)


  y_sm <- zoo::rollmedian(y, k = roll_k, fill = NA, align = "center")
  good <- is.finite(t) & is.finite(y_sm)


  if(sum(good) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, n_grid))


  t2 <- t[good]
  y2 <- y_sm[good]


  if(max(t2) == min(t2)){
    return(rep(median(y2, na.rm = TRUE), n_grid))
  }


  t2 <- (t2 - min(t2)) / (max(t2) - min(t2))
  grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_grid)


  approx(x = t2, y = y2, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
}


build_phase_curves <- function(data, value_col, n_grid = 100, roll_k = 11){
  keys <- data %>%
    distinct(participant, condition, trial, task) %>%
    arrange(condition, participant, trial, task)


  out_list <- vector("list", nrow(keys))


  for(i in seq_len(nrow(keys))){
    key <- keys[i, ]


    g <- data %>%
      filter(
        participant == key$participant,
        condition == key$condition,
        trial == key$trial,
        task == key$task
      )


    curve <- smooth_resample_phase(g, value_col, n_grid = n_grid, roll_k = roll_k)


    out_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      participant = key$participant,
      condition = key$condition,
      trial = key$trial,
      phase = key$task
    ) %>%
      bind_cols(as_tibble_row(setNames(as.list(curve), paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid)))))
  }


  bind_rows(out_list)
}


make_long_phase_curve <- function(df, measure_name){
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^t[0-9]+$"),
      names_to = "t_idx",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_idx = as.numeric(gsub("^t", "", t_idx)),
      time_norm = (t_idx - 1) / (max(t_idx) - 1),
      measure = measure_name
    ) %>%
    select(participant, condition, trial, phase, measure, time_norm, value)
}


prepare_gamm_phase_data <- function(phase_df, measure_name){
  make_long_phase_curve(phase_df, measure_name) %>%
    mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Controlli", "Interventi")),
      trial = factor(trial, levels = c("T0", "T1")),
      phase = factor(phase, levels = phase_levels),
      measure = factor(measure, levels = c("SAI", "PAI")),
      subj = factor(participant),
      subj_visit = factor(paste(participant, trial, sep = "__")),
      subj_visit_phase = factor(paste(participant, trial, phase, sep = "__")),
      curve_group = interaction(condition, trial, phase, drop = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(value), is.finite(time_norm))
}


build_gamm_prediction_grid <- function(long_df, n_time = 200){
  pred_grid <- expand.grid(
    time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_time),
    condition = levels(long_df$condition),
    trial = levels(long_df$trial),
    phase = levels(long_df$phase)
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      measure = long_df$measure[1],
      subj = long_df$subj[1],
      subj_visit = long_df$subj_visit[1],
      subj_visit_phase = long_df$subj_visit_phase[1],
      curve_group = factor(
        interaction(condition, trial, phase, drop = TRUE),
        levels = levels(long_df$curve_group)
      )
    )


  pred_grid
}


plot_gamm_fitted_trajectories <- function(pred_grid, measure_name){
  plot_df <- pred_grid %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = fit, color = condition_label, linetype = trial)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(measure_name, "fitted trajectories by phase, condition, and visit"),
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = paste(measure_name, "fitted value"),
      color = "Group"
    )
}


build_gamm_did_curves <- function(pred_grid){
  pred_grid %>%
    select(time_norm, measure, phase, condition, trial, fit) %>%
    mutate(ct = paste(condition, trial, sep = "__")) %>%
    select(-condition, -trial) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ct, values_from = fit) %>%
    mutate(DiD = (Interventi__T1 - Interventi__T0) - (Controlli__T1 - Controlli__T0))
}


plot_gamm_did_curves <- function(did_df, measure_name){
  ggplot(did_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = DiD)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(measure_name, "trajectory difference-in-differences"),
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = "(EMDR T1 - T0) - (TAU T1 - T0)"
    )
}


build_gamm_within_condition_change <- function(pred_grid){
  pred_grid %>%
    select(time_norm, measure, phase, condition, trial, fit) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(time_norm, measure, phase, condition),
      names_from = trial,
      values_from = fit
    ) %>%
    mutate(change_T1_minus_T0 = T1 - T0)
}


plot_gamm_within_condition_change <- function(change_df, measure_name){
  plot_df <- change_df %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = change_T1_minus_T0, color = condition_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(measure_name, "within-condition change from T0 to T1"),
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = "T1 - T0",
      color = "Group"
    )
}


fit_measure_gamm <- function(phase_df, measure_name, n_time = 200){
  long_df <- prepare_gamm_phase_data(phase_df, measure_name)


  model <- bam(
    value ~ condition * trial * phase +
      s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(subj, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
    data = long_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )


  pred_grid <- build_gamm_prediction_grid(long_df, n_time = n_time)
  pred_grid$fit <- predict(model, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")


  did_df <- build_gamm_did_curves(pred_grid)
  within_condition_df <- build_gamm_within_condition_change(pred_grid)


  list(
    long_df = long_df,
    model = model,
    pred_grid = pred_grid,
    did_df = did_df,
    within_condition_df = within_condition_df,
    plots = list(
      fitted_trajectories = plot_gamm_fitted_trajectories(pred_grid, measure_name),
      difference_in_differences = plot_gamm_did_curves(did_df, measure_name),
      within_condition_change = plot_gamm_within_condition_change(within_condition_df, measure_name)
    )
  )
}


build_clinical_prediction_grid <- function(long_df, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), n_time = 200,
                                           bin_breaks = NULL){
  clinical_levels <- quantile(long_df$clinical_c, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(is.null(bin_breaks)){
    bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_df$clinical_c)
  }


  pred_grid <- expand.grid(
    time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_time),
    condition = levels(long_df$condition),
    trial = levels(long_df$trial),
    phase = levels(long_df$phase),
    clinical_c = clinical_levels
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      measure = long_df$measure[1],
      subj = long_df$subj[1],
      subj_visit = long_df$subj_visit[1],
      subj_visit_phase = long_df$subj_visit_phase[1],
      curve_group = factor(
        interaction(condition, trial, phase, drop = TRUE),
        levels = levels(long_df$curve_group)
      ),
      clinical_bin = cut(clinical_c, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
      clinical_curve_group = factor(
        interaction(trial, phase, clinical_bin, drop = TRUE),
        levels = levels(long_df$clinical_curve_group)
      ),
      Clinical_level = factor(
        outcome_improvement_label(clinical_c),
        levels = c("LessImproved", "MoreImproved")
      )
    )


  pred_grid
}


plot_clinical_fitted_trajectories <- function(pred_grid, measure_name, outcome_label){
  plot_df <- pred_grid %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = fit, color = condition_label, linetype = trial)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(Clinical_level ~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(measure_name, "fitted trajectories moderated by", outcome_label),
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = paste(measure_name, "fitted value"),
      color = "Group"
    )
}


build_clinical_difference_curves <- function(pred_grid){
  pred_grid %>%
    select(time_norm, measure, condition, trial, phase, Clinical_level, fit) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(time_norm, measure, condition, trial, phase),
      names_from = Clinical_level,
      values_from = fit
    ) %>%
    mutate(Clinical_diff = MoreImproved - LessImproved) %>%
    group_by(time_norm, measure, trial, phase) %>%
    summarise(Clinical_diff = mean(Clinical_diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}


plot_clinical_difference_curves <- function(clinical_diff_df, measure_name, outcome_label){
  ggplot(clinical_diff_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = Clinical_diff, linetype = trial)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "#2F2F2F") +
    facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(measure_name, "condition-adjusted trajectory differences by degree of", outcome_label),
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = "MoreImproved - LessImproved"
    )
}


fit_measure_clinical_prediction_gamm <- function(phase_df, clin, measure_name,
                                                 outcome_name, outcome_label,
                                                 probs = c(0.25, 0.75),
                                                 n_time = 200){
  long_df <- prepare_gamm_phase_data(phase_df, measure_name) %>%
    left_join(
      clin %>% select(participant, condition, all_of(outcome_name)),
      by = c("participant", "condition")
    ) %>%
    rename(clinical_outcome = all_of(outcome_name)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(clinical_outcome)) %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_c = as.numeric(scale(clinical_outcome, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
      clinical_bin = cut(clinical_c, breaks = make_two_bin_breaks(clinical_c), include.lowest = TRUE),
      clinical_curve_group = interaction(trial, phase, clinical_bin, drop = TRUE)
    )


  clinical_bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_df$clinical_c)
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_bin = cut(clinical_c, breaks = clinical_bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
      clinical_curve_group = interaction(trial, phase, clinical_bin, drop = TRUE)
    )


  gamm_1 <- bam(
    value ~
      condition * trial * phase +
      clinical_c * trial * phase +
      s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(subj, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
    data = long_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )


  gamm_2 <- bam(
    value ~
      condition * trial * phase +
      clinical_c * trial * phase +
      s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(time_norm, by = clinical_curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(subj, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
    data = long_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )


  pred_grid <- build_clinical_prediction_grid(
    long_df,
    probs = probs,
    n_time = n_time,
    bin_breaks = clinical_bin_breaks
  )
  pred_grid$fit <- predict(gamm_2, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")
  diff_df <- build_clinical_difference_curves(pred_grid)


  list(
    measure = measure_name,
    outcome = outcome_name,
    outcome_label = outcome_label,
    long_df = long_df,
    gamm_1 = gamm_1,
    gamm_2 = gamm_2,
    pred_grid = pred_grid,
    diff_df = diff_df,
    plots = list(
      fitted_trajectories = plot_clinical_fitted_trajectories(pred_grid, measure_name, outcome_label),
      difference_curves = plot_clinical_difference_curves(diff_df, measure_name, outcome_label)
    )
  )
}


build_transition_features <- function(phase_df, n_grid = 100){
  tcols <- paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid))


  wide <- phase_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(participant, condition, trial),
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = all_of(tcols),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    )


  rows <- vector("list", nrow(wide))


  for(i in seq_len(nrow(wide))){
    row <- wide[i, ]


    c_oc1 <- as.numeric(row[paste0("oc1_", tcols)])
    c_script <- as.numeric(row[paste0("script_", tcols)])
    c_oc2 <- as.numeric(row[paste0("oc2_", tcols)])


    if(any(!is.finite(c_oc1)) || any(!is.finite(c_script)) || any(!is.finite(c_oc2))){
      next
    }


    med_oc1 <- safe_median(c_oc1)
    med_script <- safe_median(c_script)
    med_oc2 <- safe_median(c_oc2)


    script_minus_baseline <- c_script - med_oc1
    recovery_minus_script <- c_oc2 - med_script


    rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      participant = row$participant,
      condition = row$condition,
      trial = row$trial,
      baseline = med_oc1,
      script = med_script,
      recovery_phase = med_oc2,
      reactivity = med_script - med_oc1,
      recovery = med_oc2 - med_script,
      return_to_baseline = med_oc2 - med_oc1,
      return_to_baseline_abs = abs(med_oc2 - med_oc1),
      reactivity_auc = curve_auc(abs(script_minus_baseline)),
      reactivity_peak = curve_peak(script_minus_baseline),
      reactivity_trough = curve_trough(script_minus_baseline),
      reactivity_slope = curve_slope(script_minus_baseline),
      recovery_auc = curve_auc(abs(recovery_minus_script)),
      recovery_peak = curve_peak(recovery_minus_script),
      recovery_trough = curve_trough(recovery_minus_script),
      recovery_slope = curve_slope(recovery_minus_script)
    )
  }


  bind_rows(rows)
}


make_phase_summary <- function(phase_df){
  phase_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      phase_median = safe_median(c_across(matches("^t[0-9]+$"))),
      phase_auc = curve_auc(c_across(matches("^t[0-9]+$"))),
      phase_peak = curve_peak(c_across(matches("^t[0-9]+$"))),
      phase_trough = curve_trough(c_across(matches("^t[0-9]+$"))),
      phase_slope = curve_slope(c_across(matches("^t[0-9]+$")))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}


fit_phase_lmm <- function(df, outcome){
  form <- as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ condition * trial * phase + (1|participant)"))
  mod <- lmer(form, data = df, REML = TRUE)


  list(
    model = mod,
    anova = anova(mod),
    summary = summary(mod)
  )
}


make_trial_change_scores <- function(df, id_cols){
  value_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c(id_cols, "trial"))


  wide <- df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = all_of(id_cols),
      names_from = trial,
      values_from = all_of(value_cols)
    )


  trial_vars <- names(wide)[grepl("_(T0|T1)$", names(wide))]
  base_vars <- unique(gsub("_(T0|T1)$", "", trial_vars))


  for(v in base_vars){
    c0 <- paste0(v, "_T0")
    c1 <- paste0(v, "_T1")
    if(all(c(c0, c1) %in% names(wide))){
      wide[[paste0(v, "_change")]] <- wide[[c1]] - wide[[c0]]
    }
  }


  wide
}


group_change_tests <- function(df, variables){
  rows <- list()


  for(v in variables){
    dsub <- df %>%
      select(condition, all_of(v)) %>%
      filter(is.finite(.data[[v]]), !is.na(condition))


    x <- dsub %>% filter(condition == "Interventi") %>% pull(all_of(v))
    y <- dsub %>% filter(condition == "Controlli") %>% pull(all_of(v))


    if(length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) next


    tt <- t.test(x, y)


    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      variable = v,
      interventi_n = length(x),
      controlli_n = length(y),
      interventi_mean = mean(x),
      controlli_mean = mean(y),
      t_stat = unname(tt$statistic),
      p_value = tt$p.value,
      cohens_d = cohen_d(x, y)
    )
  }


  bind_rows(rows) %>% arrange(p_value)
}


spearman_assoc_table <- function(df, outcome, variables = NULL){
  if(is.null(variables)){
    variables <- names(df)
  }


  variables <- setdiff(variables, outcome)
  rows <- list()


  for(v in variables){
    ok <- is.finite(df[[v]]) & is.finite(df[[outcome]])
    if(sum(ok) < 6) next


    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df[[v]][ok], df[[outcome]][ok], method = "spearman"))


    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      variable = v,
      n = sum(ok),
      rho = unname(ct$estimate),
      p_value = ct$p.value
    )
  }


  if(!length(rows)){
    return(tibble(
      variable = character(),
      n = integer(),
      rho = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric()
    ))
  }


  bind_rows(rows) %>% arrange(p_value)
}


build_phase_change_curves <- function(phase_df, n_grid = 100){
  tcols <- paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid))


  wide <- phase_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(participant, condition, phase),
      names_from = trial,
      values_from = all_of(tcols)
    )


  rows <- vector("list", nrow(wide))


  for(i in seq_len(nrow(wide))){
    row <- wide[i, ]
    x0 <- as.numeric(row[paste0(tcols, "_T0")])
    x1 <- as.numeric(row[paste0(tcols, "_T1")])


    if(any(!is.finite(x0)) || any(!is.finite(x1))) next


    rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      participant = row$participant,
      condition = row$condition,
      phase = row$phase
    ) %>%
      bind_cols(as_tibble_row(setNames(as.list(x1 - x0), tcols)))
  }


  bind_rows(rows)
}


plot_phase_change_curves <- function(change_df, title_txt, ylab_txt){
  long <- change_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^t[0-9]+$"),
      names_to = "idx",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(idx = as.numeric(gsub("^t", "", idx))) %>%
    group_by(condition, phase, idx) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(condition, phase) %>%
    mutate(time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n())) %>%
    ungroup()


  long <- long %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  ggplot(long, aes(x = time_norm, y = value, color = condition_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(title = title_txt, x = "Normalized time", y = ylab_txt, color = "Group")
}


plot_subject_phase_trajectories <- function(phase_df, variable_label, ylab_txt = NULL){
  ylab_txt <- ylab_txt %||% paste(variable_label, "value")
  panel_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    condition_label = factor(c("TAU", "EMDR"), levels = c("TAU", "EMDR")),
    trial = factor(c("T0", "T1"), levels = c("T0", "T1")),
    phase = factor(phase_levels, levels = phase_levels)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_label = unname(phase_labels[as.character(phase)]),
      panel_label = paste(condition_label, trial, phase_label, sep = " - ")
    ) %>%
    pull(panel_label)


  long <- phase_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^t[0-9]+$"),
      names_to = "idx",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      idx = as.numeric(gsub("^t", "", idx)),
      time_norm = (idx - min(idx, na.rm = TRUE)) /
        (max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) - min(idx, na.rm = TRUE)),
      condition_label = condition_display(condition),
      trial = factor(trial, levels = c("T0", "T1")),
      phase = factor(phase, levels = phase_levels),
      phase_label = unname(phase_labels[as.character(phase)]),
      panel_label = factor(
        paste(condition_label, trial, phase_label, sep = " - "),
        levels = panel_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(time_norm), is.finite(value))


  mean_df <- long %>%
    group_by(condition_label, trial, phase, panel_label, time_norm) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


  ggplot(long, aes(x = time_norm, y = value)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = participant),
      color = "#8C9AA6",
      alpha = 0.22,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = mean_df,
      aes(y = mean_value, color = condition_label, group = interaction(condition_label, trial, phase)),
      linewidth = 1.25
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel_label, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(variable_label, "subject-level trajectories by group, visit, and phase"),
      subtitle = "Thin lines are participants; thick lines are group means.",
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = ylab_txt,
      color = "Group mean"
    )
}


plot_individual_clinical_scatter <- function(df, clinical_var, feature_var,
                                             clinical_label = NULL,
                                             feature_label = NULL,
                                             title_txt = NULL){
  clinical_label <- clinical_label %||% paste(clinical_var, "(T1 - T0)")
  feature_label <- feature_label %||% feature_var
  title_txt <- title_txt %||% paste(feature_label, "vs", clinical_label)


  d <- df %>%
    select(participant, condition, all_of(c(clinical_var, feature_var))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[clinical_var]]), is.finite(.data[[feature_var]])) %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  if(nrow(d) >= 3){
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d[[clinical_var]], d[[feature_var]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    stat_label <- paste0(
      "Spearman rho = ", sprintf("%.2f", unname(ct$estimate)),
      "\np = ", format.pval(ct$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001),
      "\nn = ", nrow(d)
    )
  } else {
    stat_label <- paste0("n = ", nrow(d))
  }


  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[clinical_var]], y = .data[[feature_var]], color = condition_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, color = "#2F7FD0", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, color = "#2F7FD0", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 2.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#2F2F2F",
                linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.04, vjust = 1.15,
             label = stat_label, size = 3.6, label.size = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x = paste0(clinical_label, " (T1 - T0; lower = more improvement)"),
      y = feature_label,
      color = "Group"
    )
}

dat <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    participant = str_squish(as.character(participant)),

  count(participant, name = "n_conditions") %>%
  filter(n_conditions > 1)


if(nrow(cond_check) > 0){
  warning("Some participants appear in more than one condition. Resolve this before trusting the results.")
}


paired_participants <- dat %>%
  distinct(participant, condition, trial) %>%
  count(participant, condition, name = "n_trials") %>%
  filter(n_trials == 2) %>%
  select(participant, condition)

)

)


clin <- clin_source %>%
  rename(participant = PZ) %>%
  mutate(
    participant = str_squish(as.character(participant)),
    IES_T0 = as.numeric(IEST0TOT),
    IES_T1 = as.numeric(IEST1TOT),
    IES_change = IES_T1 - IES_T0,
    IES_intrusion_T0 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST0", c(1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 14, 16, 20)),
    IES_intrusion_T1 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST1", c(1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 14, 16, 20)),
    IES_intrusion_change = IES_intrusion_T1 - IES_intrusion_T0,
    IES_avoidance_T0 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST0", c(5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 17, 22)),
    IES_avoidance_T1 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST1", c(5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 17, 22)),
    IES_avoidance_change = IES_avoidance_T1 - IES_avoidance_T0,
    IES_hyperarousal_T0 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST0", c(4, 10, 15, 18, 19, 21)),
    IES_hyperarousal_T1 = ies_subscale_sum(., "IEST1", c(4, 10, 15, 18, 19, 21)),
    IES_hyperarousal_change = IES_hyperarousal_T1 - IES_hyperarousal_T0,
    STAI_Y1_T0 = as.numeric(STAY1T0TOT),
    STAI_Y1_T1 = as.numeric(STAY1T1TOT),
    STAI_Y1_change = STAI_Y1_T1 - STAI_Y1_T0,
    STAI_Y2_T0 = as.numeric(STAY2T0TOT),
    STAI_Y2_T1 = as.numeric(STAY2T1TOT),
    STAI_Y2_change = STAI_Y2_T1 - STAI_Y2_T0,
    CAPS_T0 = as.numeric(CAPST0TOT),
    CAPS_T1 = as.numeric(CAPST1TOT),
    CAPS_change = CAPS_T1 - CAPS_T0
  ) %>%
  inner_join(paired_participants, by = "participant") %>%
  select(
    participant,
    condition,
    IES_T0,
    IES_T1,
    IES_change,
    IES_intrusion_T0,
    IES_intrusion_T1,
    IES_intrusion_change,
    IES_avoidance_T0,
    IES_avoidance_T1,
    IES_avoidance_change,

    IES_hyperarousal_T1,
    IES_hyperarousal_change,

    STAI_Y2_T0,

  )

gamm_plot_files <- imap_dfr(

    tibble(

# =========================================================
# ANALYSIS 08: mLFPCA FEATURE SCREENING, CAPS REGRESSION, AND RECONSTRUCTED CURVES
# =========================================================
time_cols <- paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid))


choose_ncomp <- function(sdev, pve = 0.90, max_n = 3){
  if(length(sdev) == 0 || all(!is.finite(sdev))) return(0L)


  total_var <- sum(sdev^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!is.finite(total_var) || total_var <= 0) return(0L)


  var_expl <- sdev^2 / total_var
  cumvar <- cumsum(var_expl)
  k <- which(cumvar >= pve)[1]


  if(is.na(k)) k <- length(sdev)
  as.integer(min(k, max_n))
}


run_multilevel_fpca_phase <- function(df_phase, measure_name, phase_name,
                                      pve_between = 0.90,
                                      pve_within = 0.90,
                                      max_between = 2,
                                      max_within = 2){
  d <- df_phase %>%
    filter(phase == phase_name) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(time_cols), is.finite)) %>%
    arrange(participant, trial)


  if(nrow(d) < 4){
    return(list(
      measure = measure_name,
      phase = phase_name,
      mu = rep(NA_real_, length(time_cols)),
      between_pca = NULL,
      within_pca = NULL,
      kb = 0L,
      kw = 0L,
      features = tibble(participant = character(), condition = factor())
    ))
  }


  Y <- as.matrix(d[, time_cols])
  cond_map <- d %>% distinct(participant, condition)


  mu <- colMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE)


  subj_mean_df <- d %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(time_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")


  Y_between <- as.matrix(subj_mean_df[, time_cols])
  Y_between_centered <- sweep(Y_between, 2, mu, "-")


  pca_between <- prcomp(Y_between_centered, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  kb <- choose_ncomp(pca_between$sdev, pve = pve_between, max_n = max_between)


  if(kb > 0){
    between_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_between$x[, seq_len(kb), drop = FALSE])
    names(between_scores) <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_bPC", seq_len(kb))
    between_scores$participant <- subj_mean_df$participant
  } else {
    between_scores <- tibble(participant = subj_mean_df$participant)
  }


  subj_mean_map <- subj_mean_df %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_subjmean"), all_of(time_cols))


  d_with_means <- d %>%
    left_join(subj_mean_map, by = "participant")


  Y_within <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(d_with_means), ncol = length(time_cols))
  colnames(Y_within) <- time_cols


  for(j in seq_along(time_cols)){
    Y_within[, j] <- d_with_means[[time_cols[j]]] - d_with_means[[paste0(time_cols[j], "_subjmean")]]
  }


  complete_within <- complete.cases(Y_within)
  Y_within <- Y_within[complete_within, , drop = FALSE]
  within_meta <- d_with_means[complete_within, c("participant", "condition", "trial", "phase")]


  if(nrow(Y_within) >= 4){
    pca_within <- prcomp(Y_within, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
    kw <- choose_ncomp(pca_within$sdev, pve = pve_within, max_n = max_within)
  } else {
    pca_within <- NULL
    kw <- 0L
  }


  if(kw > 0){
    within_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_within$x[, seq_len(kw), drop = FALSE])
    names(within_scores) <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC", seq_len(kw))
    within_scores <- bind_cols(within_meta, within_scores)


    within_change <- within_scores %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(participant, condition, phase),
        names_from = trial,
        values_from = starts_with(paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC"))
      )


    for(k in seq_len(kw)){
      base <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC", k)
      c0 <- paste0(base, "_T0")
      c1 <- paste0(base, "_T1")
      if(all(c(c0, c1) %in% names(within_change))){
        within_change[[paste0(base, "_change")]] <- within_change[[c1]] - within_change[[c0]]
      }
    }


    within_change <- within_change %>%
      select(participant, condition, ends_with("_change"))
  } else {
    within_change <- cond_map
  }


  features <- between_scores %>%
    left_join(cond_map, by = "participant") %>%
    left_join(within_change, by = c("participant", "condition"))


  list(
    measure = measure_name,
    phase = phase_name,
    mu = mu,
    between_pca = pca_between,
    within_pca = pca_within,
    kb = kb,
    kw = kw,
    features = features
  )
}


fpca_assoc_screen <- function(df, outcome, variables = NULL){
  if(is.null(variables)){
    variables <- names(df)
  }


  feat_cols <- setdiff(variables, c("participant", "condition", outcome))
  spearman_assoc_table(df, outcome = outcome, variables = feat_cols)
}


plot_fpca_reconstruction_all <- function(ml_list, which = "between", pcs = 1:2){
  build_df <- function(mlobj){
    if(which == "between"){
      if(is.null(mlobj$between_pca) || mlobj$kb < 1) return(NULL)
      keep_pcs <- pcs[pcs <= mlobj$kb]
      if(!length(keep_pcs)) return(NULL)
      eig <- mlobj$between_pca$rotation[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
      scores <- mlobj$between_pca$x[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      if(is.null(mlobj$within_pca) || mlobj$kw < 1) return(NULL)
      keep_pcs <- pcs[pcs <= mlobj$kw]
      if(!length(keep_pcs)) return(NULL)
      eig <- mlobj$within_pca$rotation[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
      scores <- mlobj$within_pca$x[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
    }


    mu <- mlobj$mu
    time <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(mu))
    out <- list()


    for(j in seq_along(keep_pcs)){
      sd_pc <- sd(scores[, j], na.rm = TRUE)


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu,
        type = "Mean",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu + 2 * sd_pc * eig[, j],
        type = "+2SD",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu - 2 * sd_pc * eig[, j],
        type = "-2SD",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )
    }


    bind_rows(out) %>%
      mutate(
        measure = mlobj$measure,
        phase = mlobj$phase
      )
  }


  df_all <- bind_rows(lapply(ml_list, build_df))
  if(!nrow(df_all)) return(NULL)


  df_all <- df_all %>%
    mutate(
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("oc1", "script", "oc2")),
      measure = factor(measure, levels = c("SAI", "PAI"))
    )


  ggplot(df_all, aes(x = time, y = value, color = PC, linetype = type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(measure ~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste("FPCA reconstructed curves (", which, ")", sep = ""),
      x = "Normalized time",
      y = "Value"
    )
}
```

```{r source-nermi, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, fig.show='hide'}
evalq({


# Pointwise 95% CI for the full four-trajectory DiD contrast.
# Uses model coefficient covariance (not independent curve intervals).
save_did_confidence_intervals <- function(model, grid, prefix) {
  re <- vapply(model$smooth, function(s) if (inherits(s, "random.effect")) s$label else "", "")
  X <- predict(model, newdata = grid, type = "lpmatrix", exclude = re[nzchar(re)])
  V <- vcov(model)
  b <- coef(model)
  keys <- c("Interventi__T1", "Interventi__T0", "Controlli__T1", "Controlli__T0")
  out <- list()
  groups <- if ("measure" %in% names(grid)) as.character(grid$measure) else rep(prefix, nrow(grid))
  for (m in unique(groups)) for (ph in unique(as.character(grid$phase))) {
    rows <- which(groups == m & as.character(grid$phase) == ph)
    for (tt in sort(unique(grid$time_norm[rows]))) {
      ids <- rows[grid$time_norm[rows] == tt]
      lookup <- paste(grid$condition[ids], grid$trial[ids], sep = "__")
      if (length(ids) != 4L || !setequal(lookup, keys)) stop("Unexpected DiD prediction grid")
      xx <- as.numeric(c(1, -1, -1, 1) %*% X[ids[match(keys, lookup)], , drop = FALSE])
      fit <- sum(xx * b)
      se <- sqrt(max(0, as.numeric(t(xx) %*% V %*% xx)))
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- data.frame(measure=m, phase=ph, time_norm=tt,
        DiD=fit, se=se, lower95=fit-1.9599639845*se, upper95=fit+1.9599639845*se)
    }
  }
  result <- dplyr::bind_rows(out)
  dir.create("manuscript_gamm_ci", recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  write.csv(result, file.path("manuscript_gamm_ci", paste0(prefix, "_did_ci.csv")), row.names=FALSE)
  fig <- ggplot2::ggplot(result, ggplot2::aes(time_norm, DiD)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype=2) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin=lower95, ymax=upper95), alpha=.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() + ggplot2::facet_grid(measure ~ phase, scales="free_y") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(x="Normalized phase time", y="(EMDR T1-T0) - (TAU T1-T0)")
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("manuscript_gamm_ci", paste0(prefix, "_did_ci.png")),
     fig, width=11, height=if (length(unique(groups))>1) 7 else 4.5, dpi=300)
  invisible(result)
}

library(tidyverse)

survey_raw <- read_excel(survey_path)


# =========================================================

n_grid <- 100
roll_k <- 11

moderation_plot_dir <- "NerMI_moderation_plots"

# =========================================================
# HELPERS

coalesce_override <- function(base_df, override_df, by){
  override_cols <- setdiff(names(override_df), by)


  merged <- base_df %>%
    full_join(override_df, by = by, suffix = c("", "_override"))


  for(col in override_cols){
    override_col <- paste0(col, "_override")
    if(override_col %in% names(merged)){
      merged[[col]] <- dplyr::coalesce(merged[[override_col]], merged[[col]])
      merged[[override_col]] <- NULL
    }
  }


  merged
}


row_sum_cols <- function(df, cols){
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if(!length(cols)) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))


  mat <- df %>%
    select(all_of(cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()


  rowSums(mat, na.rm = FALSE)
}


ies_subscale_sum <- function(df, visit_prefix, items){
  row_sum_cols(df, paste0(visit_prefix, items))
}


`%||%` <- function(x, y){
  if(is.null(x)) y else x
}


safe_plot_name <- function(...){
  name <- paste(..., sep = "_")
  name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", name)
  name <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", name)
  tolower(name)
}


condition_display <- function(x){
  factor(
    dplyr::recode(
      as.character(x),
      "Controlli" = "TAU",
      "Interventi" = "EMDR",
      .default = as.character(x)
    ),
    levels = c("TAU", "EMDR")
  )
}


condition_palette <- c("TAU" = "#4C78A8", "EMDR" = "#F58518")
phase_labels <- c("oc1" = "OC1", "script" = "Script", "oc2" = "OC2")

                               width = 12, height = 7){

  out_file <- file.path(directory, paste0(safe_plot_name(file_stem), ".png"))


  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )


  out_file
}


make_two_bin_breaks <- function(x){
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!all(is.finite(rng))){
    return(c(-Inf, 0, Inf))
  }
  if(diff(rng) == 0){
    rng <- rng + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  }
  seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 3)
}


outcome_improvement_label <- function(x){

  if_else(x <= med, "MoreImproved", "LessImproved")
}

clinical_assoc_by_outcome <- function(df, outcomes, variables){
  map2_dfr(outcomes$outcome, outcomes$label, function(outcome_name, outcome_label){
    fpca_assoc_screen(df, outcome = outcome_name, variables = variables) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        outcome_label = outcome_label,
        .before = 1
      )
  })
}


fit_top_feature_model <- function(df, results_tbl, outcome_name, n_top = 4){
  top_features <- results_tbl %>%
    filter(outcome == outcome_name, is.finite(p_value)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    pull(variable)


  if(!length(top_features)){
    return(list(model = NULL, top_features = character()))
  }


  form_txt <- paste(
    outcome_name,
    "~ condition +",
    paste(top_features, collapse = " + ")
  )


  list(
    model = lm(as.formula(form_txt), data = df),
    top_features = top_features
  )
}


smooth_resample_phase <- function(df_phase, value_col, n_grid = 100, roll_k = 11){
  y <- df_phase[[value_col]]
  t <- df_phase$timestamps


  keep <- is.finite(t) & is.finite(y)
  t <- t[keep]
  y <- y[keep]


  if(length(y) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, n_grid))


  ord <- order(t)
  t <- t[ord]
  y <- y[ord]


  t <- t - min(t, na.rm = TRUE)


  y_sm <- zoo::rollmedian(y, k = roll_k, fill = NA, align = "center")
  good <- is.finite(t) & is.finite(y_sm)


  if(sum(good) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, n_grid))


  t2 <- t[good]
  y2 <- y_sm[good]


  if(max(t2) == min(t2)){
    return(rep(median(y2, na.rm = TRUE), n_grid))
  }


  t2 <- (t2 - min(t2)) / (max(t2) - min(t2))
  grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_grid)


  approx(x = t2, y = y2, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
}


build_phase_curves <- function(data, value_col, n_grid = 100, roll_k = 11){
  keys <- data %>%
    distinct(participant, condition, trial, task) %>%
    arrange(condition, participant, trial, task)


  out_list <- vector("list", nrow(keys))


  for(i in seq_len(nrow(keys))){
    key <- keys[i, ]


    g <- data %>%
      filter(
        participant == key$participant,
        condition == key$condition,
        trial == key$trial,
        task == key$task
      )


    curve <- smooth_resample_phase(g, value_col, n_grid = n_grid, roll_k = roll_k)


    out_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      participant = key$participant,
      condition = key$condition,
      trial = key$trial,
      phase = key$task
    ) %>%
      bind_cols(as_tibble_row(setNames(as.list(curve), paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid)))))
  }


  bind_rows(out_list)
}


make_long_phase_curve <- function(df, measure_name){
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^t[0-9]+$"),
      names_to = "t_idx",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_idx = as.numeric(gsub("^t", "", t_idx)),
      time_norm = (t_idx - 1) / (max(t_idx) - 1),
      measure = measure_name
    ) %>%
    select(participant, condition, trial, phase, measure, time_norm, value)
}


plot_subject_phase_trajectories <- function(phase_df, variable_label, ylab_txt = NULL){
  ylab_txt <- ylab_txt %||% paste(variable_label, "value")
  panel_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    condition_label = factor(c("TAU", "EMDR"), levels = c("TAU", "EMDR")),
    trial = factor(c("T0", "T1"), levels = c("T0", "T1")),
    phase = factor(phase_levels, levels = phase_levels)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_label = unname(phase_labels[as.character(phase)]),
      panel_label = paste(condition_label, trial, phase_label, sep = " - ")
    ) %>%
    pull(panel_label)


  long <- phase_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^t[0-9]+$"),
      names_to = "idx",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      idx = as.numeric(gsub("^t", "", idx)),
      time_norm = (idx - min(idx, na.rm = TRUE)) /
        (max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) - min(idx, na.rm = TRUE)),
      condition_label = condition_display(condition),
      trial = factor(trial, levels = c("T0", "T1")),
      phase = factor(phase, levels = phase_levels),
      phase_label = unname(phase_labels[as.character(phase)]),
      panel_label = factor(
        paste(condition_label, trial, phase_label, sep = " - "),
        levels = panel_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(time_norm), is.finite(value))


  mean_df <- long %>%
    group_by(condition_label, trial, phase, panel_label, time_norm) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


  ggplot(long, aes(x = time_norm, y = value)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = participant),
      color = "#8C9AA6",
      alpha = 0.22,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = mean_df,
      aes(y = mean_value, color = condition_label, group = interaction(condition_label, trial, phase)),
      linewidth = 1.25
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel_label, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(variable_label, "subject-level trajectories by group, visit, and phase"),
      subtitle = "Thin lines are participants; thick lines are group means.",
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = ylab_txt,
      color = "Group mean"
    )
}


plot_individual_clinical_scatter <- function(df, clinical_var, feature_var,
                                             clinical_label = NULL,
                                             feature_label = NULL,
                                             title_txt = NULL){
  clinical_label <- clinical_label %||% paste(clinical_var, "(T1 - T0)")
  feature_label <- feature_label %||% feature_var
  title_txt <- title_txt %||% paste(feature_label, "vs", clinical_label)


  d <- df %>%
    select(participant, condition, all_of(c(clinical_var, feature_var))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[clinical_var]]), is.finite(.data[[feature_var]])) %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  if(nrow(d) >= 3){
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d[[clinical_var]], d[[feature_var]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    stat_label <- paste0(
      "Spearman rho = ", sprintf("%.2f", unname(ct$estimate)),
      "\np = ", format.pval(ct$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001),
      "\nn = ", nrow(d)
    )
  } else {
    stat_label <- paste0("n = ", nrow(d))
  }


  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[clinical_var]], y = .data[[feature_var]], color = condition_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, color = "#2F7FD0", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, color = "#2F7FD0", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 2.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#2F2F2F",
                linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.04, vjust = 1.15,
             label = stat_label, size = 3.6, label.size = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x = paste0(clinical_label, " (T1 - T0; lower = more improvement)"),
      y = feature_label,
      color = "Group"
    )
}


build_prediction_grid <- function(long_df, n_time = 200){
  pred_grid <- expand.grid(
    time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_time),
    measure = levels(long_df$measure),
    condition = levels(long_df$condition),
    trial = levels(long_df$trial),
    phase = levels(long_df$phase)
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()


  pred_grid$subj <- long_df$subj[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit <- long_df$subj_visit[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit_phase <- long_df$subj_visit_phase[1]
  pred_grid$curve_group <- interaction(
    pred_grid$measure,
    pred_grid$condition,
    pred_grid$trial,
    pred_grid$phase,
    drop = TRUE
  )


  pred_grid
}

}

build_caps_prediction_grid <- function(long_df, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), n_time = 200,
                                       bin_breaks = NULL){
  caps_levels <- quantile(long_df$CAPS_c, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(is.null(bin_breaks)){
    bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_df$CAPS_c)
  }


  pred_grid <- expand.grid(
    time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_time),
    measure = levels(long_df$measure),
    condition = levels(long_df$condition),
    trial = levels(long_df$trial),
    phase = levels(long_df$phase),
    CAPS_c = caps_levels
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()


  pred_grid$subj <- long_df$subj[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit <- long_df$subj_visit[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit_phase <- long_df$subj_visit_phase[1]
  pred_grid$curve_group <- interaction(
    pred_grid$measure,
    pred_grid$condition,
    pred_grid$trial,
    pred_grid$phase,
    drop = TRUE
  )
  pred_grid$CAPS_bin <- cut(pred_grid$CAPS_c, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  pred_grid$caps_curve_group <- factor(
    interaction(pred_grid$measure, pred_grid$trial, pred_grid$phase, pred_grid$CAPS_bin, drop = TRUE),
    levels = levels(long_df$caps_curve_group)
  )
  pred_grid$CAPS_level <- factor(
    outcome_improvement_label(pred_grid$CAPS_c),
    levels = c("LessImproved", "MoreImproved")
  )


  pred_grid
}


plot_caps_fitted_trajectories <- function(pred_grid_caps){
  plot_df <- pred_grid_caps %>%
    mutate(condition_label = condition_display(condition))


  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = fit, color = condition_label, linetype = trial)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(measure + CAPS_level ~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = "Fitted trajectories moderated by CAPS improvement",
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = "Fitted value",
      color = "Group"
    )
}


build_caps_difference_curves <- function(pred_grid_caps){
  pred_grid_caps %>%
    select(time_norm, measure, condition, trial, phase, CAPS_level, fit) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(time_norm, measure, condition, trial, phase),
      names_from = CAPS_level,
      values_from = fit
    ) %>%
    mutate(CAPS_diff = MoreImproved - LessImproved) %>%
    group_by(time_norm, measure, trial, phase) %>%
    summarise(CAPS_diff = mean(CAPS_diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}


plot_caps_difference_curves <- function(caps_diff_df){
  ggplot(caps_diff_df, aes(x = time_norm, y = CAPS_diff, linetype = trial)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "#2F2F2F") +
    facet_grid(measure ~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = "Condition-adjusted trajectory differences by degree of CAPS improvement",
      x = "Normalized time within phase",
      y = "MoreImproved - LessImproved"
    )
}


build_clinical_prediction_grid <- function(long_df, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), n_time = 200,
                                           bin_breaks = NULL){
  clinical_levels <- quantile(long_df$clinical_c, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(is.null(bin_breaks)){
    bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_df$clinical_c)
  }


  pred_grid <- expand.grid(
    time_norm = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_time),
    measure = levels(long_df$measure),
    condition = levels(long_df$condition),
    trial = levels(long_df$trial),
    phase = levels(long_df$phase),
    clinical_c = clinical_levels
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()


  pred_grid$subj <- long_df$subj[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit <- long_df$subj_visit[1]
  pred_grid$subj_visit_phase <- long_df$subj_visit_phase[1]
  pred_grid$curve_group <- interaction(
    pred_grid$measure,
    pred_grid$condition,
    pred_grid$trial,
    pred_grid$phase,
    drop = TRUE
  )
  pred_grid$clinical_bin <- cut(pred_grid$clinical_c, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  pred_grid$clinical_curve_group <- factor(
    interaction(pred_grid$measure, pred_grid$trial, pred_grid$phase, pred_grid$clinical_bin, drop = TRUE),
    levels = levels(long_df$clinical_curve_group)
  )
  pred_grid$Clinical_level <- factor(
    outcome_improvement_label(pred_grid$clinical_c),
    levels = c("LessImproved", "MoreImproved")
  )


  pred_grid
}

fit_clinical_moderation <- function(long_vm, clin, outcome_name, outcome_label,
                                    probs = c(0.25, 0.75), n_time = 200){
  long_df <- long_vm %>%
    left_join(clin %>% select(participant, condition, all_of(outcome_name)), by = c("participant", "condition")) %>%
    rename(clinical_outcome = all_of(outcome_name)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(clinical_outcome)) %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_c = as.numeric(scale(clinical_outcome, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
      curve_group_clinical = interaction(measure, trial, phase, drop = TRUE)
    )


  clinical_bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_df$clinical_c)
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    mutate(
      clinical_bin = cut(clinical_c, breaks = clinical_bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
      clinical_curve_group = interaction(curve_group_clinical, clinical_bin, drop = TRUE)
    )


  gamm_1 <- bam(
    value ~
      measure * condition * trial * phase +
      clinical_c * measure * trial * phase +
      s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(subj, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
    data = long_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )


  gamm_2 <- bam(
    value ~
      measure * condition * trial * phase +
      clinical_c * measure * trial * phase +
      s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(time_norm, by = clinical_curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
      s(subj, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
      s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
    data = long_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )


  pred_grid <- build_clinical_prediction_grid(
    long_df,
    probs = probs,
    n_time = n_time,
    bin_breaks = clinical_bin_breaks
  )
  pred_grid$fit <- predict(gamm_2, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")


  list(
    outcome = outcome_name,
    outcome_label = outcome_label,
    long_df = long_df,
    gamm_1 = gamm_1,
    gamm_2 = gamm_2,
    pred_grid = pred_grid,
    diff_df = build_clinical_difference_curves(pred_grid)
  )
}


time_cols <- paste0("t", seq_len(n_grid))


choose_ncomp <- function(sdev, pve = 0.90, max_n = 3){
  if(length(sdev) == 0 || all(!is.finite(sdev))) return(0L)


  total_var <- sum(sdev^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!is.finite(total_var) || total_var <= 0) return(0L)


  var_expl <- sdev^2 / total_var
  cumvar <- cumsum(var_expl)
  k <- which(cumvar >= pve)[1]


  if(is.na(k)) k <- length(sdev)
  as.integer(min(k, max_n))
}


run_multilevel_fpca_phase <- function(df_phase, measure_name, phase_name,
                                      pve_between = 0.90,
                                      pve_within = 0.90,
                                      max_between = 2,
                                      max_within = 2){
  d <- df_phase %>%
    filter(phase == phase_name) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(time_cols), is.finite)) %>%
    arrange(participant, trial)


  if(nrow(d) < 4){
    return(list(
      measure = measure_name,
      phase = phase_name,
      mu = rep(NA_real_, length(time_cols)),
      between_pca = NULL,
      within_pca = NULL,
      kb = 0L,
      kw = 0L,
      features = tibble(participant = character(), condition = factor())
    ))
  }


  Y <- as.matrix(d[, time_cols])
  cond_map <- d %>% distinct(participant, condition)


  mu <- colMeans(Y, na.rm = TRUE)


  subj_mean_df <- d %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(time_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")


  Y_between <- as.matrix(subj_mean_df[, time_cols])
  Y_between_centered <- sweep(Y_between, 2, mu, "-")


  pca_between <- prcomp(Y_between_centered, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  kb <- choose_ncomp(pca_between$sdev, pve = pve_between, max_n = max_between)


  if(kb > 0){
    between_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_between$x[, seq_len(kb), drop = FALSE])
    names(between_scores) <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_bPC", seq_len(kb))
    between_scores$participant <- subj_mean_df$participant
  } else {
    between_scores <- tibble(participant = subj_mean_df$participant)
  }


  subj_mean_map <- subj_mean_df %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_subjmean"), all_of(time_cols))


  d_with_means <- d %>%
    left_join(subj_mean_map, by = "participant")


  Y_within <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(d_with_means), ncol = length(time_cols))
  colnames(Y_within) <- time_cols


  for(j in seq_along(time_cols)){
    Y_within[, j] <- d_with_means[[time_cols[j]]] - d_with_means[[paste0(time_cols[j], "_subjmean")]]
  }


  complete_within <- complete.cases(Y_within)
  Y_within <- Y_within[complete_within, , drop = FALSE]
  within_meta <- d_with_means[complete_within, c("participant", "condition", "trial", "phase")]


  if(nrow(Y_within) >= 4){
    pca_within <- prcomp(Y_within, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
    kw <- choose_ncomp(pca_within$sdev, pve = pve_within, max_n = max_within)
  } else {
    pca_within <- NULL
    kw <- 0L
  }


  if(kw > 0){
    within_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_within$x[, seq_len(kw), drop = FALSE])
    names(within_scores) <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC", seq_len(kw))
    within_scores <- bind_cols(within_meta, within_scores)


    within_change <- within_scores %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(participant, condition, phase),
        names_from = trial,
        values_from = starts_with(paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC"))
      )


    for(k in seq_len(kw)){
      base <- paste0(measure_name, "_", phase_name, "_wPC", k)
      c0 <- paste0(base, "_T0")
      c1 <- paste0(base, "_T1")
      if(all(c(c0, c1) %in% names(within_change))){
        within_change[[paste0(base, "_change")]] <- within_change[[c1]] - within_change[[c0]]
      }
    }


    within_change <- within_change %>%
      select(participant, condition, ends_with("_change"))
  } else {
    within_change <- cond_map
  }


  subj_features <- between_scores %>%
    left_join(cond_map, by = "participant") %>%
    left_join(within_change, by = c("participant", "condition"))


  list(
    measure = measure_name,
    phase = phase_name,
    mu = mu,
    between_pca = pca_between,
    within_pca = pca_within,
    kb = kb,
    kw = kw,
    features = subj_features
  )
}


fpca_assoc_screen <- function(df, outcome, variables = NULL){
  if(is.null(variables)){
    variables <- names(df)
  }


  feat_cols <- setdiff(variables, c("participant", "condition", outcome))
  rows <- list()


  for(v in feat_cols){
    ok <- is.finite(df[[v]]) & is.finite(df[[outcome]])
    if(sum(ok) < 6) next


    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df[[v]][ok], df[[outcome]][ok], method = "spearman"))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      variable = v,
      n = sum(ok),
      rho = unname(ct$estimate),
      p_value = ct$p.value
    )
  }


  if(!length(rows)){
    return(tibble(
      variable = character(),
      n = integer(),
      rho = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric()
    ))
  }


  bind_rows(rows) %>% arrange(p_value)
}


build_fpca_reconstruction_data <- function(ml_list, which = "between", pcs = 1:2){
  build_df <- function(mlobj){
    if(which == "between"){
      if(is.null(mlobj$between_pca) || mlobj$kb < 1) return(NULL)
      keep_pcs <- pcs[pcs <= mlobj$kb]
      if(!length(keep_pcs)) return(NULL)
      eig <- mlobj$between_pca$rotation[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
      scores <- mlobj$between_pca$x[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      if(is.null(mlobj$within_pca) || mlobj$kw < 1) return(NULL)
      keep_pcs <- pcs[pcs <= mlobj$kw]
      if(!length(keep_pcs)) return(NULL)
      eig <- mlobj$within_pca$rotation[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
      scores <- mlobj$within_pca$x[, keep_pcs, drop = FALSE]
    }


    mu <- mlobj$mu
    time <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(mu))
    out <- list()


    for(j in seq_along(keep_pcs)){
      sd_pc <- sd(scores[, j], na.rm = TRUE)


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu,
        type = "Mean",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu + 2 * sd_pc * eig[, j],
        type = "+2SD",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )


      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        time = time,
        value = mu - 2 * sd_pc * eig[, j],
        type = "-2SD",
        PC = paste0("PC", keep_pcs[j])
      )
    }


    bind_rows(out) %>%
      mutate(
        measure = mlobj$measure,
        phase = mlobj$phase
      )
  }


  df_all <- bind_rows(lapply(ml_list, build_df))
  if(!nrow(df_all)) return(tibble())


  df_all %>%
    mutate(
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("oc1", "script", "oc2")),
      measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Valence", "Motivation")),
      PC = factor(PC, levels = c("PC1", "PC2")),
      type = factor(type, levels = c("-2SD", "+2SD", "Mean"))
    )
}


plot_fpca_reconstruction_all <- function(ml_list, which = "between", pcs = 1:2){
  df_all <- build_fpca_reconstruction_data(ml_list, which = which, pcs = pcs)
  if(!nrow(df_all)) return(NULL)


  p <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = time, y = value, color = PC, linetype = type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(measure ~ phase, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("PC1" = "#F8766D", "PC2" = "#00BFC4"), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("-2SD" = "dashed", "+2SD" = "dotted", "Mean" = "solid"), drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste("FPCA reconstructed curves (", which, ")", sep = ""),
      x = "Normalized time",
      y = "Value"
    )


  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}

  print(anova(full_gamm))
})


message("Saved Joint GAMM output: ", joint_gamm_output_file)


# =========================================================
# ANALYSIS 02: FITTED TRAJECTORY PLOTS
# =========================================================
pred_grid <- build_prediction_grid(long_vm, n_time = 200)
pred_grid$fit <- predict(full_gamm, newdata = pred_grid, type = "response")


did_df <- build_did_curves(pred_grid)
# Generate DiD confidence intervals directly; no source() or separate script needed.

print(primary_trajectory_plots$within_condition_change)


# =========================================================
# ANALYSIS 03: CAPS-MODERATED GAMMS
# =========================================================
long_vm_caps <- long_vm %>%
  left_join(clin %>% select(participant, condition, CAPS_change), by = c("participant", "condition")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(CAPS_change)) %>%
  mutate(
    CAPS_c = as.numeric(scale(CAPS_change, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
    curve_group_caps = interaction(measure, trial, phase, drop = TRUE)
  )


caps_bin_breaks <- make_two_bin_breaks(long_vm_caps$CAPS_c)
long_vm_caps <- long_vm_caps %>%
  mutate(
    CAPS_bin = cut(CAPS_c, breaks = caps_bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    caps_curve_group = interaction(curve_group_caps, CAPS_bin, drop = TRUE)
  )


message("CAPS model sample: ", n_distinct(long_vm_caps$participant), " participants.")


caps_gamm_1 <- bam(
  value ~
    measure * condition * trial * phase +
    CAPS_c * measure * trial * phase +
    s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
    s(subj, bs = "re") +
    s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
    s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
  data = long_vm_caps,
  method = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)


caps_gamm_2 <- bam(
  value ~
    measure * condition * trial * phase +
    CAPS_c * measure * trial * phase +
    s(time_norm, by = curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
    s(time_norm, by = caps_curve_group, bs = "cr", k = 6) +
    s(subj, bs = "re") +
    s(subj_visit, bs = "re") +
    s(subj_visit_phase, bs = "re"),
  data = long_vm_caps,
  method = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)


clinical_moderation_output_files <- tibble(
  outcome = "CAPS_change",
  outcome_label = "CAPS change",
  model = c("GAMM 1", "GAMM 2"),
  file = c(
    save_print_output("CAPS_change_GAMM_1", {
      cat("\n==== CAPS GAMM 1 ====\n")
      print(summary(caps_gamm_1))
      print(anova(caps_gamm_1))
    }),
    save_print_output("CAPS_change_GAMM_2", {
      cat("\n==== CAPS GAMM 2 ====\n")
      print(summary(caps_gamm_2))
      print(anova(caps_gamm_2))
    })
  )
)


message("Saved CAPS GAMM outputs: ", paste(clinical_moderation_output_files$file, collapse = "; "))


pred_grid_caps <- build_caps_prediction_grid(
  long_vm_caps,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.75),
  n_time = 200,
  bin_breaks = caps_bin_breaks
)
pred_grid_caps$fit <- predict(caps_gamm_2, newdata = pred_grid_caps, type = "response")


caps_diff_df <- build_caps_difference_curves(pred_grid_caps)


clinical_moderation_plots <- list(
  CAPS_change = list(
    fitted_trajectories = plot_caps_fitted_trajectories(pred_grid_caps),
    difference_curves = plot_caps_difference_curves(caps_diff_df)
  )
)


clinical_moderation_plot_files <- tibble(
  outcome = "CAPS_change",
  outcome_label = "CAPS change",
  plot_type = c("fitted_trajectories", "difference_curves"),
  file = c(
    save_moderation_plot(
      clinical_moderation_plots$CAPS_change$fitted_trajectories,
      "CAPS_change",
      "fitted_trajectories"
    ),
    save_moderation_plot(
      clinical_moderation_plots$CAPS_change$difference_curves,
      "CAPS_change",

    )
  )
)


print(clinical_moderation_plots$CAPS_change$fitted_trajectories)
print(clinical_moderation_plots$CAPS_change$difference_curves)


clinical_moderation_results <- set_names(
  map2(

for(i in seq_len(nrow(additional_change_targets))){

  gamm_2_output_file <- save_print_output(paste(outcome_name, "GAMM_2", sep = "_"), {
    cat("\n==== ", outcome_label, " GAMM 2 ====\n", sep = "")
    print(summary(res$gamm_2))

  new_output_files <- tibble(

    paste(new_plot_files$file, collapse = "; ")
  )
}
```
